# 1. Introduction

This project analyzes breast cancer gene expression data
using the GSE42568 dataset from the NCBI GEO database.

The main objective is to identify differentially expressed
genes between breast cancer and normal tissue samples.

# 2. Required Libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
```

# 3. Data Collection

```{r}
download.file(
  "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE42nnn/GSE42568/matrix/GSE42568_series_matrix.txt.gz",
  destfile = "data/GSE42568_series_matrix.txt.gz",
  mode = "wb",
  method = "libcurl"
)
```

# 4. Data Loading

```{r}
gse <- getGEO(
  filename = "data/GSE42568_series_matrix.txt.gz"
)

expression_data <- exprs(gse)
metadata <- pData(gse)

dim(expression_data)
head(metadata$title)
```

# 5. Sample Classification

```{r}
sample_titles <- metadata$title

group <- ifelse(
  grepl("normal", sample_titles, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Normal",
  "Cancer"
)

group <- factor(group)

table(group)
```

# 6. Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(Group = group),
       aes(x = Group, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Samples") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 7. Principal Component Analysis

```{r}
gene_variance <- apply(expression_data, 1, var,
                       na.rm = TRUE)

nonzero_genes <- gene_variance > 0 &
  !is.na(gene_variance)

expression_filtered <- expression_data[nonzero_genes, ]

pca <- prcomp(t(expression_filtered), scale. = TRUE)

pca_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca$x[,2],
  Group = group
)

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "PCA of Breast Cancer Samples") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 8. Differential Gene Expression Analysis

```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

fit_model <- lmFit(expression_data, design)

contrast <- makeContrasts(
  Cancer - Normal,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit_model, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

results <- topTable(
  fit2,
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(results)
```

# 9. Significant Genes

```{r}
significant_genes <- results %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 1)

nrow(significant_genes)
head(significant_genes)
```

# 10. Volcano Plot

```{r}
results$Significance <- ifelse(
  results$adj.P.Val < 0.05 &
    abs(results$logFC) > 1,
  "Significant",
  "Not Significant"
)

ggplot(results,
       aes(logFC, -log10(adj.P.Val),
           color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot of Differentially Expressed Genes") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 11. Heatmap

```{r}
gene_variance <- apply(expression_data, 1, var,
                       na.rm = TRUE)

top_genes <- names(
  sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:30]

heatmap_data <- expression_data[top_genes, ]

annotation <- data.frame(Group = group)
rownames(annotation) <- colnames(heatmap_data)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  main = "Breast Cancer Gene Expression Heatmap"
)
```

# 12. Conclusion

This analysis explores breast cancer gene expression
patterns and identifies differentially expressed genes
between cancer and normal tissue samples.
